notes: Godot 4.3 puzzle-platformer for Godot Wild Jam #78 (theme: Eraser). Main menu, tutorial, and five levels; the player erases blocks to reach the goal. Indie Flower is SIL OFL 1.1 (OFL text bundled at src/assets/fonts/OFL.txt). Art is original in-tree images/SVGs; no audio. icon.svg is an original pink-eraser mark (md5 0fc40e30f653bfadbe3e2869076bb27b), replacing the Godot default project icon. No Git LFS, no addons, no editor .tmp.
